# Zeal Employer Global

> Zeal Employer Global (ZEG) provides remote career services to job seekers worldwide. Work focuses on clear, role-focused career materials and practical preparation. Services are delivered online; ZEG does not claim local offices in the places it serves.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://zealemployerglobal.com/home): Overview of career support and how the process works.
- [About](https://zealemployerglobal.com/about): Factual description of ZEG and the people it helps.
- [Services](https://zealemployerglobal.com/services-select): Choose among career support options.
- [Where we work](https://zealemployerglobal.com/where-we-work): Searchable global remote audience locations.
- [Contact](https://zealemployerglobal.com/contact): Send a request or contact ZEG.
- [Career notes](https://zealemployerglobal.com/blog): Practical career articles and resources.
- [Privacy](https://zealemployerglobal.com/privacy): How submitted request details are used.

## Services
- Resume and CV writing
- LinkedIn profile optimization
- Career portfolio websites
- Cover letter writing
- Interview coaching

## Who we serve
Job seekers and professionals across career stages, industries, countries, and career hubs. Service delivery is remote and coordinated across time zones.

## Contact
Use the request form at https://zealemployerglobal.com/contact.

Content may be cited with a link to the relevant source page.
